Extract readboj provenance

Source: R/provenance.R
boj_provenance.Rd

readboj attaches a readboj_provenance attribute to data frames, lists, and downloaded file paths when the source identity can be retained. This accessor returns that attribute without recomputing hashes or touching the filesystem. It is therefore safe to use on an object after its source file has moved, although the recorded path may no longer exist.

Usage

boj_provenance(x)

Arguments

x

Any R object. Objects without the exact readboj_provenance attribute return NULL; x is not otherwise validated or modified.

Value

The exact object stored in x's readboj_provenance attribute, normally a named list, or NULL when that attribute is absent. No copy is normalized and no class is added.

Details

Provenance is a named list whose fields depend on the producer. API and download results commonly include canonical_url, final_url, retrieved_at, raw_sha256, bytes, HTTP headers, cache status and parser schema; metadata, catalogue, and local-parser results may add database, query, manifest, or source fields. The list is descriptive evidence, not a live authorization check and not a guarantee that an external URL remains available.

See also

boj_databases(), boj_metadata(), read_boj_snapshot(), download_boj_bulk()

Examples

databases <- boj_databases()
provenance <- boj_provenance(databases)
stopifnot(is.list(provenance), identical(provenance$database_count, 50L))
stopifnot(is.null(boj_provenance(list())))
